bio.text: The Arizona Capitol Times reported in December 2024 that Carine Werner would serve Legislative District 4 in the Arizona Senate after defeating incumbent Christine Marsh.

According to the Capitol Times, Werner had served on the governing board of the Scottsdale Unified School District since 2022 and was to chair the Senate Health and Human Services Committee and serve as vice chair of the Senate Education Committee.

sources.title: New Faces: Carine Werner | Arizona Capitol Times
